name: Toronto
intro: Toronto homeowners can stack three layers of support: Home Renovation Savings rebates, the City's HELP loans up to $125,000, and the $600 assessment rebate. Most of the housing stock is pre-1980 and gas-heated — exactly the profile where an audit pays for itself fastest.

name: Ottawa
intro: Ottawa's cold winters and large stock of 1960s–80s homes make air sealing and insulation the highest-return upgrades. An EnerGuide assessment is the required first step for the Home Renovation Savings bundled path.

name: Hamilton
intro: Hamilton, Ancaster, Dundas, and Stoney Creek are served both by non-profit service organizations and larger commercial providers — one of the better-supplied audit markets in Ontario.

name: Mississauga
intro: Mississauga's post-war and 1970s–90s subdivisions are prime candidates for attic top-ups and air sealing, and the GTA has the province's deepest bench of registered energy advisors.

name: Brampton
intro: Brampton's newer housing stock still leaves money on the table — heat pump rebates up to $12,000 don't require an assessment, but audit-first sequencing usually changes what you buy.

name: York Region
intro: Vaughan, Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, and Aurora sit in the service area of several of Canada's largest service organizations — comparing more than one quote is realistic here.

name: Kitchener–Waterloo & Cambridge
intro: Waterloo Region is home to Reep Green Solutions, one of Ontario's longest-running non-profit service organizations, alongside province-wide commercial providers.

name: London
intro: London's century homes and post-war neighbourhoods respond strongly to envelope work — insulation and air sealing rebates under Home Renovation Savings run up to $7,700 on the assessment path.

name: Barrie & Simcoe County
intro: Barrie, Collingwood, Wasaga Beach, and Bradford are covered by the Environment Network, Simcoe County's community service organization, plus province-wide providers.

name: Peterborough & the Kawarthas
intro: GreenUP has delivered EnerGuide evaluations in Peterborough for decades — one of the community-based non-profits that anchor Ontario's audit network.

name: Kingston & Eastern Ontario
intro: Kingston's limestone-era and post-war homes are classic audit candidates, served by regional non-profits and province-wide providers.

name: Niagara Region
intro: St. Catharines, Niagara Falls, Welland, and Port Colborne fall inside Green Venture's service territory along with commercial providers covering the peninsula.
